plugins.name: prompt-enhancer
plugins.description: Rewrites a vague draft in the prompt box into a specific prompt using the project's instructions, skills and conversation, then sends it on your click.

plugins.name: assumption-check
plugins.description: Claude logs its assumptions and intent as it works; review them in a side pane and send corrections back mid-turn.

plugins.name: plain-answers
plugins.description: Plain-language, self-contained answers that end with Done / Not done / Next steps; a recap when a work turn ends without them, and /catchup for a session you switch back to.
